title: Whats Actually Eating All The Storage Space On Your Android Phone
report:
**Summary**
If you're running out of storage space on your Android phone, there are several ways to free up space. Uninstalling or archiving unused apps is a good place to start, as they can take up a significant amount of space. You can also delete or back up images and videos to free up storage space. By using these methods, you can efficiently claw back storage space on your device.

**Key Facts**

1. **Unused apps**: Uninstalling or archiving unused apps is an effective way to free up storage space on your Android phone.
2. **Auto-archive**: Android has an "auto-archive" feature that can automatically archive apps you rarely use when you run low on storage, freeing up nearly 60% of an app's storage space.
3. **Google Photos**: Using Google Photos to back up images and videos can help free up storage space on your phone, with up to 15GB of free cloud storage available.
4. **Cloud storage limits**: While 15GB of free cloud storage is available, it may not be enough to accommodate years' worth of images and videos, and a Google One subscription may be required for more storage.
5. **Easy cleanup**: The Photos app allows you to easily tidy up your phone by backing up images and videos to the cloud and then deleting them from your device to free up space.
